text:
Rina (PM): dropping the v2 Prompt Sets & Evals mock here: https://www.figma.com/file/zz
Omar (Eng): Heads up: huge inline diffs kill the client. Lazy-load diffs, show metadata first. Also we need immutable snapshot ids for audits.
Tasha (Design): Copy nit: 'Approve' ambiguous. Suggest 'Approve snapshot' and 'Request changes'. Also make pass/fail icons not rely on color alone.
Ben (Security): Audit entries must include user, role, timestamp, snapshot_id, and snapshot_hash. Retention policy TBD but log format should be exportable CSV.
A11yBot: Automated check: pass badge contrast 2.5:1 on small text. AA requires 3:1. Recommend darker fill or bold text.
Rina (PM): Good. Add rationale textbox on approve so reviewers can leave context. If overall score < threshold require confirmation and mark as 'conditional approve'.
Omar (Eng): API sketch: POST /evals/{snapshot_id}/approve { reviewer, role, note, action } -> returns audit_id. We'll add signed URLs for blob downloads.
Tasha (Design): Keyboard flows: modal traps focus, Enter triggers primary only when not typing in rationale, Esc prompts if unsaved text. Visible focus ring on thumbnails.
Ben (Security): Also webhook option for enterprise so external SIEMs can ingest approvals.
Rina (PM): Action items: Tasha update frames + a11y fixes; Omar add API + lazy diffs; Ben draft audit CSV schema. Aim to freeze for grooming tomorrow.
